verdict.rationale: BVNK is fundamentally an API-first payments platform: authenticated via Hawk (docs-1/20/29), driven entirely through REST endpoints with a sandbox for safe automated testing (docs-3/22/28/31), and webhooks for event-driven automation (docs-2/32) — all of which support headless/CI use. An official 'agent-wallet-cli' is also documented (bvnk-probe-2), reinforcing programmatic/automation-friendly usage. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples/tutorials, no first-party docs explicitly describing 'headless' or CI integration workflows, and no independent hands-on confirmation of automation in CI.
